intent: Show several permitted test branches ending at the same boundary. The repeated failure is local to the stated method, not a claim that every possible task route fails.
source:
**Frame:** The workload tests the required method only within the permitted abstract task surface. Every branch returns the same impossibility boundary.

**Screen / system text:**
`SPECIFIED METHOD: CANNOT PRODUCE REQUIRED RESULT`

**Provenance:** `invented`.
title: Permitted tests meet the same impossibility boundary
